name: ModelMeasures
description: Represents a collection of ModelMeasure objects.
remarks: Each measure is represented by a ModelMeasure object. Use the ModelMeasures property of the Model object to return the ModelMeasures collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns an integer that represents the number of objects in the collection.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or index number of the object.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(MeasureName As String, AssociatedTable As ModelTable, Formula As String, FormatInformation As Variant, [Description As Variant]) As ModelMeasure
methods.description: Adds a model measure to the model.

parameters.name: MeasureName
parameters.description: The name of the model measure.

parameters.name: AssociatedTable
parameters.description: The model table associated with the model measure. This is the table that contains the model measure, as seen in the Field List task pane.

parameters.name: Formula
parameters.description: The Data Analysis Expressions (DAX) formula, inserted as a string.

parameters.name: FormatInformation
parameters.description: The formatting of the model measure. See Remarks.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description associated with the model measure.
